decisions.D4_static_source: S2 public-domain DEM aggregated to 0.25 degrees (primary); GEFS ancillary fields only as an optional cross-check if a probe confirms them
decisions.scope: Stages 0-2 only; Stage 3 (geography-aware model) needs its own protocol and approval

approval.observation_free_inputs_inspected: time-invariant IMD valid-cell footprint (1301 cells) and grid coordinates only

decision_rule.geographic_gap: paired interval of (zone value minus all-cell value) excludes zero in the development year AND the sign matches in the consumed final-test year (post-hoc)
decision_rule.otherwise: report no evidence of a geography-specific deficiency at this resolution; requirement stays PARTIAL
decision_rule.stage_3_recommended_only_if: at least one zone shows a gap for RMSE, heavy-event CSI or bias on at least one track

design.head_A: synoptic state, per case, existing three pseudo-regimes, unchanged
design.head_C: geographic forcing, per cell: static zone x forecast-time forcing strength

forcing_strength.forcing: component x PWAT (declared a moisture-flux proxy)
forcing_strength.resampling: bilinear from the 0.5 degree context grid to 0.25 degrees
forcing_strength.strata: terciles of forcing over the training year's cell-case pairs within the zone

immutability: any changed rule requires protocol v2

leakage.only_observation_derived_input: time-invariant IMD footprint, until the frozen land-sea mask replaces it

metrics: FSS where the zone is contiguous enough

populations.2024_note: already used for selection and calibration; development evidence only

post_hoc_labels.2019: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS OF THE COMPLETED 2019 FINAL TEST
post_hoc_labels.2025: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY ANALYSIS OF THE COMPLETED 2025 FINAL TEST

questions.Q1: Do Raw and each model differ in bias or RMSE inside a zone compared with all cells?
questions.Q2: Does the improvement over Raw differ in a zone compared with all cells?
questions.Q3: Within a zone, does heavy-rain frequency bias or corrected-model skill differ between strong and weak forcing terciles?

0.what: acquire static geography into a versioned hashed artifact static_geography_v1

1.what: static zones and verification of frozen models stratified by zone

2.what: forecast-time forcing-strength strata from U850, V850, PWAT, Q700 and static geometry; same stratified verification

3.requires: separate protocol and approval after Stage 1-2 results

static_geography.distance: great-circle from cell centre to nearest ocean cell centre of the frozen land-sea mask
static_geography.licence_rule: record licence text, file, version and SHA-256; stop if redistribution of derived 0.25 degree values is not clearly permitted

stop_conditions: licence does not permit the intended use
aggregated field misaligns with the 49x49 grid
land-sea mask disagrees materially with the IMD footprint over the coast
any zone has fewer than 20 cells
any step needs a frozen model or threshold to change
title: Coastal / orographic geographic-forcing protocol v1

uncertainty.note: optimistic; cells in a case are correlated; expected-by-chance share reported beside any count

zones.naming: rule-based geographic-forcing zone; never a learned, validated or official regime
